method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: First & First is a small (about 20-25 people) New York strategy and analytics boutique founded around 2016-17. It does consumer insights, cultural-trend, brand-health and influencer research for brands, positioned as 'the nexus of strategy and analytics'.
business_type: Boutique strategy, research and analytics consultancy

differentiators.text: Data-driven brand and consumer strategy for large brands (postings name Meta, Nike, Cash App and Regeneron), on project and retainer bases.
differentiators.significance: Marketing-strategy flavour rather than corporate or operations strategy; small-firm exposure to senior clients.

tradeoffs.text: Very small firm: little formal structure or training, and sources disagree on founding year, size and office location (Brooklyn moving to the Financial District per one posting).
tradeoffs.significance: Ask about mentorship, career path and stability directly.
